Seven utility proposals

Value is not enough by itself.

Instructor explanation

A useful agent opportunity has a clear job, variable evidence or next steps, approved sources, measurable value, an accountable owner, and a consequence level that can be controlled. Some ideas should use search, retrieval, or fixed rules instead.

Information technology manages records and business processes. Operational technology monitors or controls physical processes. The distinction changes consequence and approval, even when the interface looks similar.

Value, readiness, and consequence

High value, high readiness

High value, low readiness

Improve evidence and ownership before building.

Low value, high readiness

Use a simpler tool or do not automate.

High consequence

Reduce authority, strengthen review, or reject the proposal.

Evidence boundary
The use cases are bounded instructional patterns. They do not establish production readiness, regulatory approval, cybersecurity approval, procurement authority, or operational authorization. EPA operational-technology guidance supports the consequence boundary.
